_rules: Release tracker evidence for STATUS_DASHBOARD.md (rendered by tools/cloud/dashboard.py). Status is DERIVED, never typed: any gate FAIL or BLOCKED -> BLOCKED; any gate PENDING / NOT STARTED -> TESTING; an item not implemented -> DEVELOPMENT; every gate PASS -> READY FOR OWNER APPROVAL. A gate is PASS only with evidence in 'evidence'. window stays UNKNOWN unless the remaining gates have a date. Merging, production installs and publishing always wait for the owner's explicit GO.
